body_html:
The Lumi High Back Synchro-Tilter brings a refined, contoured silhouette to any workspace, pairing a breathable high-transparency mesh back with a generously cushioned seat for genuine all-day comfort. Its synchro-tilt mechanism keeps the body supported through every recline, while the back frame folds over so it never digs into your shoulders. Equally at home in a private office, a commercial floor, or a home setup, Lumi is an ergonomic office chair designed to look as considered as it feels.

Features

  • Synchro-tilter mechanism with multi-position tilt lock and tilt tension adjustment
  • Contoured back frame that folds over so the frame does not dig into shoulders when leaning back
  • Breathable, high-transparency grey mesh back
  • Generous, thick seat cushion with a waterfall front edge
  • Height-adjustable T-arms with sliding and rotating armcaps
  • Pneumatic seat height adjustment
  • Dual-wheel carpet casters

Specifications

Overall dimensions measure 25.75"W x 24"D x 38.75"H with a pneumatic seat-height range of 18" to 22.5", and the chair weighs 37.5 lbs. The seat is available in Grade 1 seating textiles or LuxPlus upholstery, paired with a grey mesh back. GREENGUARD and GREENGUARD Gold certified for low chemical emissions, and made in Canada by Global Furniture Group under a 2-year warranty.

Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote online or call 1-800-835-9565 to order the Lumi for your team.
